{{Top|leg}}
An '''Environment Scanner''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that was capable of scanning [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] for breathability, toxins, and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. Environment Scanners were integrated into the [[AV-1S Scout Armor]] manufactured by [[GTU]],<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> and in [[LesTech]]'s [[M38-series explorer droid]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
